I’ve got to re-establish power from the core to the satellite dish. To do so, I need to manipulate the circuit breakers for a specific color combination. The left column represents the core and contains a right and left column with a color indicator. A specific combination of colors must exist in each row for power to flow properly to the corresponding row in the satellite dish. The row in the column under the satellite dish will illuminate green if a correct color combination exists in the corresponding core column. If I get the satellite row to be green in color I will make the power connection. Looks like clicking the up button works the left side and clicking the down button works the colors on the right. Clicking the right or left button swaps the column colors on the bottom row.

Each statue in the room features an icon of land, sea, or the sun on its staff. The goal is to get the beam of light emitting from the statue to match its icon. For example, statues with the Sun Icon need a yellow light emitting from the statue. Statues with a Water Icon need a blue light emitting from the statue. Statues with the land icon need a red light emitting from the statue.
There are two wooden wheels at the entrance of room. One wheel rotates the statues, the other changes the beam of light emitted from the statue between the two wheels. Using observation skills, change the beams of light on each statue so it matches the icon on the staff the statue is holding.
Notice the tomb at the center of the room. There are three types of icons etched onto the tomb: Land, Water, and the sun. Above each icon is a jewel that is being hit by a beam of light. Rotate all the statues (using one of the wooden wheels) so the correct beam of light hits the correct jewel above the icon.
